verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Ribrianne's Eternal Love — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Ribrianne's Eternal Love as a Ki Blast Ultimate using a heart-shaped projectile and 300 Ki.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current reference material lists Parallel Quest 137 — Tournament of Power Round 2. Independent community documentation identifies the skill as an Ultimate Finish drop; this evidence is retained explicitly rather than inferred from the quest listing alone.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as true because an independent skill-drop source explicitly identifies Ribrianne's Eternal Love as an Ultimate Finish reward from PQ137.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Ribrianne's Eternal Love is kept distinct from Pretty Cannon and its charged Max Love Cannon variation; Pretty Cannon powers this Ultimate but is a separate Super Skill.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage values are not promoted as canonical database values because version stability is not established.

records.name: Ribrianne's Eternal Love
records.character_source: Ribrianne; Future Warrior documented by current references
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 137 — Tournament of Power Round 2 — Ultimate Finish reward
records.skill_description: Fire a heart-shaped Ki Blast that pierces through the opponent; repeated Pretty Cannon hits increase the damage of this Ultimate.
records.mechanics_notes: The user temporarily takes on the Super Ribrianne form, rises and fires a heart-shaped projectile. Pretty Cannon hits power up Eternal Love, with the attack's output increasing as the associated setup is accumulated. Current reference material also documents an uppercut/follow-up interaction in the attack description.
